spec.description:
Proctor YouRippa Heavy Duty Curing & Protection Tape is an
embossed polyethylene cloth-backed protection tape coated with a natural
rubber-based adhesive, engineered specifically for temporary jobsite surface
protection. Designed with an advanced carrier that tears straight and cleanly by
hand in both directions without cutting tools, it secures floor protection
boards and concrete curing covers against heavy foot traffic. Formulated for
clean, residue-free removal, it protects delicate finished timber, stone, metal,
and cured concrete surfaces during active building works.
features:
Tears
straight and cleanly by hand in both directions without knives or scissors
Clean, residue-free removal from sensitive finishes and cured concrete
Aggressive natural rubber adhesive bonds firmly to multiple substrates
Heavy-duty embossed polyethylene cloth carrier resists tears and puncture
Waterproof backing protects seams from construction spills and wet washdowns
Secures floor protection boards, films, and concrete curing blankets
Conforms readily to corners, thresholds, and irregular profiles

Suitable for
indoor fitouts and short-term outdoor construction protection

technical.value:
Clean
residue-free removal on recommended surfaces

spec.fire:
Standard construction trade accessory rating; low
hazard
install:
Ensure floor protection sheets, concrete, or finishes are dry and free of
loose grit and dust

Lay out floor protection boards, hardboard, or concrete
curing blankets with tightly butted edges

Tear YouRippa tape cleanly by hand
across the roll to the required length

Centre the tape directly over the seam
between adjacent protection sheets

Press down firmly along the tape line
using hand pressure or a squeegee

Ensure all edges are flat to eliminate
tripping hazards from foot traffic

Peel tape cleanly away upon project
handover without leaving sticky residue
selection_checklist:
Confirm
application is temporary floor surface protection or concrete curing blanket
sealing

Verify substrate requires clean, residue-free peel-off upon project
completion

Calculate total linear metres of board joints and perimeter
perimeter masking

Ensure surfaces are dry and dust-free before tape
application
limitations:
Temporary protection tape; not designed for permanent building
envelope weather-sealing

Do not leave on sensitive porous timber finishes
beyond recommended removal period

Not a vapour-permeable building wrap
joining tape

aluminium door thresholds and window sills during trade works

retrieval.rag_summary:
Proctor YouRippa Protect Tape (Heavy Duty Curing & Protection
Tape) is an embossed polyethylene cloth tape coated with a natural rubber-based
adhesive, engineered specifically for temporary jobsite surface protection.
Hand-tearable in both directions without cutting tools, it securely joins
corflute, cardboard, hardboard, and concrete curing blankets under heavy trade
foot traffic. It removes cleanly without leaving adhesive residue or damaging
sensitive finished surfaces such as timber, tiles, polished stone, and cured
concrete.
